Format

Major sections (H2)
  • role type table.
  • Casts, arranged by directors code; H3 heading for each new initial, and Hitchcock. Each director is a distinct table, headed by director code and director normalized name..
  • Sayings Quotes from movies removed. Header line for director has code, normalized director's name, per people file Titles are redundandant wrt filmcode, denoted by T:. TZ: are unverified actors for this movie, Roles: 1. R:role, perhaps with rolename in quotes 2. RN: rolename only in quotes 3. RU: unknown role 4. RZ: uncertain assignment of actor's name to role 5. RNZ: uncertain assignment of actor's rolename: 6. RS: uncertain spelling of actor name 7. RSU: uncertain spelling of actor name, unknown role 8. RSZ: uncertain spelling, uncertain assignment of actor to role In Awards fields: A, AAN In Notes field: ER(), Eps(episode name or number) Copyright Gio Wiederhold 1988, 1989, 1991, 1996
